observations: The producer Scheduled Runtime ran and did not mutate its own task metadata.
The distinct mailbox task remained disabled and did not execute; its last_run_time stayed historical.
The mailbox title and prompt were updated before the producer invocation terminal timestamp.
The exact expected relay appeared in the mailbox.
This separates producer execution lifecycle/auto-disable from result mailbox mutation.
limitations: One successful producer-to-distinct-mailbox publication does not establish repeatability.
This transport-only probe did not bind a real ACP request digest/blob.
Automations update exposes no compare-and-swap precondition on mailbox content; mailbox reuse therefore needs a strict reclamation rule to prevent stale overwrite.
next_test: Repeat on mailbox generations 2 and 3, then simulate a missing delivery and same-generation delivery retry. Do not recycle a mailbox while a producer invocation for its current generation may still exist.
